findings.issue: The evidence miscounts the shared modules. It says "All 23 files in supabase/functions/_shared/ are reached", but `find supabase/functions/_shared -type f` and `git ls-files` both return 21 files. The coverage conclusion still holds: an independent `deno info` over the six entries reaches exactly those 21 files. Only the number in the acceptance record is wrong.
findings.fix: Change 23 to 21 in w1.md:55 and in the chat report's "Coverage" line.

findings.issue: Two protections in demo-guard.mjs have no test. (1) No lookalike-host negative case: if `isLoopback` (demo-guard.mjs:23) were loosened to a substring match like `hostname.includes('localhost')`, all 8 tests still pass, yet `https://localhost.example.com` would count as loopback and a hosted demo build would pass. (2) No page carries «تجريبي» only inside an inline <script> or attribute, so deleting the script/style stripping in visibleText (demo-guard.mjs:29) also leaves every test green. The four cases the brief requires are present and real.
findings.fix: Add one hosted-with-demo case at a lookalike origin (e.g. `https://localhost.example.com` and `https://127.0.0.1.nip.io`) that must fail. Add one hosted case where «تجريبي» appears only inside a page's <script> and must pass.

findings.issue: The SUPABASE_URL regex needs exactly one slash between the origin and the API path. I simulated in memory over the real out/: a hosted NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL with a trailing slash (`https://x.supabase.co/` gives `//functions/v1/...` literals) returns ok:false with "cannot find the Supabase origin". The check fails closed, so it is not unsafe, but the message is misleading.
findings.fix: Allow `\/+` before `(?:rest|functions|storage|auth)\/v1`, or record this edge case in the w1.md risks.

findings.issue: The guard matches the plain word «تجريبي» (it also matches «تجريبية»), which is ordinary Arabic for 'experimental'. If Anas's real content ever uses it (e.g. «مشروع تجريبي» in a journal post), every hosted production build fails, and the message tells the operator to "remove the demo rows". This follows the brief's rule and fails closed, but the false-positive direction is missing from the w1.md risks (lines 147-162).
findings.fix: Add this false-positive risk to w1.md risks and to the I40 note, or narrow the match to the seed's exact markers: «(تجريبي)», «نص تجريبي يكتبه أنس ويعتمده قبل فتح المتجر.» and «بيانات تجريبية». Changing the matcher is a product choice for the orchestrator.
